readable_name: meteor MechET A7 strict FlowER K10 vLLM inference (8xA100 QY)
task_description: meteor A7 headline Success@10 evaluation on all 28,967 strict FlowER test IDs. Uses eight independent single-A100 vLLM 0.8.5 engines, BF16, candidate batching K=10, prefix caching, formal environment execution, resumable shards, private Ceph bootstrap, and continuous default-POD heartbeat/progress logs. The versioned CUDA-12 runtime is cached on Ceph, while each GPU worker has isolated vLLM/TorchInductor/Triton compilation caches to prevent rank-zero cache contention. Backend compatibility is fail-closed and never falls back to Transformers.
